The orchestra ensemble-manifest contract (optimix-side implementation)

Source: R/manifest.R
orchestra_manifest.Rd

A versioned, hashed, provenance-complete S7 result object, property-compatible with the federation's reference orchestra_manifest. An optimix_result is adapted into one through as_orchestra_manifest(): the optimum rides in params (inferential_target = "parameters"), the engine, convergence and uncertainty-availability ride in metadata and the typed summary, and the payload is integrity-hashed so a tampered optimum is detected downstream.

Value

An S7 object of class orchestra_manifest.

See also

as_orchestra_manifest(), verify_manifest()

Other orchestra manifest: as_orchestra_manifest(), verify_manifest()

Examples

# A minimal hand-built manifest; as_orchestra_manifest() fills these
# slots (and a real payload hash) from an optimix result.
m <- orchestra_manifest(
  emitter_package = "optimix",
  emitter_version = "0.0.0.9000",
  inferential_target = "parameters",
  run_id = "example-0001",
  method = "optimix:base_optim",
  params = data.frame(par1 = 0.5, value = 0.25),
  timestamp = Sys.time(),
  data_hash = "sha256:unhashed-example"
)
m@run_id
#> [1] "example-0001"
